newsitem.title: UK: Danka extends gain after Panmure push.
newsitem.headline: Danka extends gain after Panmure push.

text.p: Shares in Danka Business Systems Plc rose for a second day on Wednesday after a recommendation on the stock yesterday from Panmure Gordon, dealers said.

Panmure analyst Nigel Davies said he set an "enterprise value" of 650p on Danka shares after the company's aquisition of Eastman Kodak Co's Office Imaging business, approved by Danka shareholders in December.
Danka shares were up 20p at 510 by 1030 GMT in thin volume of 30,250 shares. The stock dropped to an eight-month low of 445p on April 4.

Davies said Danka had earlier this month dropped to a ten percent discount to the rest of the UK market in terms of its prospective price-earnings ratio and to a 20 percent discount to the average of U.S. shares.
"Historically it has traded at a premium," he said, "there is a good growth story with Kodak and it looks very interesting at the moment."
